questions.title: top-k words with deterministic tie-break
questions.answer:
```python
import re
from collections import Counter

def top_k_words(text: str, k: int) -> list[str]:
    if k <= 0:
        return []

    words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text.lower())
    counts = Counter(words)

    return [
        word
        for word, _ in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))[:k]
    ]
```

questions.title: token-bucket rate limiter with injected clock
questions.answer:
```python
class RateLimiter:
    def __init__(self, capacity: int, refill_per_second: float):
        self.capacity = float(max(0, capacity))
        self.refill_per_second = max(0.0, float(refill_per_second))
        self.tokens = self.capacity
        self.last_time = 0.0

    def allow(self, now: float) -> bool:
        if now > self.last_time:
            elapsed = now - self.last_time
            self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + self.refill_per_second * elapsed)
            self.last_time = now

        if self.tokens >= 1.0:
            self.tokens -= 1.0
            return True

        return False
```

questions.title: edit distance with linear memory
questions.answer:

```python
def edit_distance(a: str, b: str) -> int:
    if len(a) > len(b):
        a, b = b, a

    m = len(a)
    dp = list(range(m + 1))

    for i, ch in enumerate(b, 1):
        prev_diag = dp[0]
        dp[0] = i

        for j in range(1, m + 1):
            old = dp[j]
            cost = 0 if ch == a[j - 1] else 1
            dp[j] = min(dp[j] + 1, dp[j - 1] + 1, prev_diag + cost)
            prev_diag = old

    return dp[m]
```

questions.title: SPSC ring buffer under real threads
questions.answer:
```python
import threading


class RingBuffer:
    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        if capacity <= 0:
            raise ValueError("capacity must be positive")

        self._capacity = capacity
        self._buffer = [None] * capacity
        self._head = 0
        self._tail = 0
        self._size = 0

        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._not_full = threading.Condition(self._lock)
        self._not_empty = threading.Condition(self._lock)

    def push(self, item) -> None:
        with self._not_full:
            while self._size == self._capacity:
                self._not_full.wait()

            self._buffer[self._head] = item
            self._head = (self._head + 1) % self._capacity
            self._size += 1

            self._not_empty.notify()

    def pop(self) -> object:
        with self._not_empty:
            while self._size == 0:
                self._not_empty.wait()

            item = self._buffer[self._tail]
            self._buffer[self._tail] = None
            self._tail = (self._tail + 1) % self._capacity
            self._size -= 1

            self._not_full.notify()
            return item
```
